baseline.equivalence_test: zero initial gain leaves fixed model score tensors unchanged

core_invariants: Labels and relation IDs never enter the plugin.
Subject and object query rows are pooled into two role registers; each active context key is shared by both roles.
Only valid non-entity context keys receive residual action; masked and entity keys are zero.
Every active role query context row is centered to zero sum and finite.
Quantum and classical branches use identical projections, trainable tensor shapes, gain bounds, masks, and pair chunk budget.
The connected covariance and independent-product null are both observable diagnostics.
The plugin is isolated behind the existing pre-softmax score-hook adapter.

plugins.hypothesis: Original attention behavior is the reference baseline.
A shared context key can couple pooled subject and object query roles through an input-dependent connected covariance observable.
plugins.resource_estimate: 3*num_qubits data qubits; one shared-key covariance evaluation per batch-key pair and depth
failure_signatures: connected covariance collapses to independent product
query-pair swap or key permutation equivariance fails

plugins.hypothesis: A parameter- and input-matched tensor-product covariance is the strong classical control.
plugins.resource_estimate: same projections, trainable tensors, masks, and pair budget; no joint statevector

composition.merge_rule: Run exactly one entry from the allowlist per condition; never stack score residuals.

validation.baseline_equivalence: Zero initial gain condition has exact zero intervention and leaves fixed score tensors unchanged.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: synthetic shared-key role covariance toy v1 with fixed generator seeds
reproducibility.environment: Python >=3.10, torch >=2.0; CPU default; optional single CUDA canary only after review

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Input-dependent connected covariance over a shared key, separation from the independent-product null and matched tensor control

limitations: This plan authorizes isolated implementation and toy screening only, not complete-data training.
Exact statevector behavior proves functional mechanism only, not hardware speed or quantum advantage.
Collision risk and task utility remain unresolved until later bounded audits.
